subject.title: feat: add Re-import Cookie button to OpenCode and OpenCode Go settings

question: Should this one-click recovery action scan every supported browser, with the associated Keychain and privacy prompts, or retain the repository’s Chrome-first default?
rationale: The PR intentionally chooses all-browser import, while repository guidance prefers Chrome-only imports when possible to avoid prompts; this is a user-consent and recovery-policy choice rather than a purely mechanical refactor.

options.title: Keep Chrome-first re-import
options.body: Use the existing low-prompt browser preference for the default action and preserve the cached cookie when that import fails.

options.title: Approve all-browser recovery
options.body: Permit every supported browser only with clear user-facing wording that the action may access browser cookie stores and prompt for permissions.

recommendation.title: Keep Chrome-first re-import
recommendation.body: Use the existing low-prompt browser preference for the default action and preserve the cached cookie when that import fails.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision sets the repository-wide cookie-import and permission-prompt behavior for provider settings.
